caption:
The leads already sitting in your CRM cost you nothing extra to reach again.

Every lead who went quiet 60 to 180 days ago is still in there. Most owners never text them twice.

Here's the three-message sequence that wakes them up:

Day 0: a short, no-pressure check-in

Day 4: a different angle if they went quiet (seasonal reason or specific offer)

Day 10: one last message that respects their time and closes the loop

Example workflow, illustrative, not a client account. Build it once and run it against your full list every quarter.

rationale: Fills the under-served Demonstrations slot with the first full database-reactivation message sequence shown end-to-end, distinct from every prior stage and framework already shipped, in the slideshow format current research shows pairs reel-level reach with carousel-style depth.
